result.reason: The added language covers professional and workmanlike performance, legal compliance, malicious code, and the required remedies, but it does not correctly implement the warranty periods. It applies a 12-month conformance warranty to the Site, software, and all other deliverables, rather than 12 months for software and 90 days for services, and it provides no express service-warranty period. In addition, the period runs from the Effective Date rather than delivery or completion, so later-delivered items may receive less than the required coverage. The new subsection otherwise preserves the existing commercial provisions, but its overbroad 12-month scope means it is not minimal.
